name: poe-leveling-overlay
description: ToS-compliant desktop overlay for leveling through the Path of Exile 1 campaign
author: PoE Leveling Overlay contributors

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --experimental-strip-types --test tests/parser.test.ts tests/tracker.test.ts tests/overlay-mouse.test.ts tests/watcher.test.ts tests/guide.test.ts tests/profile.test.ts tests/pob.test.ts tests/trials.test.ts tests/editor.test.ts tests/gem-cargo.test.ts tests/sources.test.ts tests/search-regex.test.ts tests/library.test.ts tests/update-errors.test.ts tests/release-tag.test.ts tests/run.test.ts tests/areas.test.ts tests/locate.test.ts tests/security.test.ts tests/plan-window.test.ts tests/gem-names.test.ts tests/pantheon.test.ts tests/timer.test.ts
scripts.render-check: electron-vite build && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --experimental-strip-types scripts/render-check/scenarios.ts && electron --no-sandbox scripts/render-check/render.mjs
